info.title: PAIMOS API
info.description:
PAIMOS — Professional & Personal AI Project OS.

This is the **public, stable scriptable contract** for PAIMOS — the canonical resource surface used by the SPA, the paimos CLI, and custom integrations: auth, users, projects, issues, comments, time entries, attachments, documents, incidents, knowledge, and GDPR ops. It is intentionally a curated subset. Internal one-off admin tooling (CSV/Jira/mite imports, dev test reports, branding writes, SSO/TOTP management, AI operations, portal internals) is deliberately omitted and is NOT part of the stability contract — those endpoints exist but may change without notice. Authentication is either a session cookie (browser) or a `paimos_*` bearer API key (machine-to-machine). Coverage policy & contribution rule: PAI-294.

sessionCookie.description: Issued by POST /api/auth/login. Browser SPA. CSRF-protected via X-CSRF-Token header for mutations (PAI-113).

bearerAPIKey.description: Long-lived API key, prefix configurable via BRAND_API_KEY_PREFIX. Created via /api/auth/api-keys.

MutationChangeEvent.description: Metadata-only mutation event emitted by GET /api/changes. Snapshot fields such as before_state, after_state, and inverse_op are intentionally omitted.

KnowledgeEntry.description: PAI-394 unified knowledge entry shape. `type` is the SQL discriminator (snake_case). Returned by every read on /api/projects/{id}/knowledge.

liveness.description: ended for every stream-closing result: completed, tests_passed, tests_failed, deployed, failed, cancelled, or drafted

event_freshness_seconds.description: Age of the newest event by server receipt time

heartbeat_freshness_seconds.description: Age of the newest supervisor heartbeat; the only active-run watchdog clock

text.description: The authoritative producer bound is 8192 UTF-8 bytes: the server truncates the transcript to at most 8192 bytes on a code-point boundary, so the value is always valid UTF-8. JSON Schema maxLength counts characters (code points) rather than bytes, so this 8192 maxLength is only a loose upper bound that multibyte transcripts never reach; validate the byte length against 8192 when the byte bound matters.

candidate_ids.description: Empty for status/note_ready; one to three active authorized delivery IDs for clarification.

selected_delivery.description: Selected delivery key, or the empty string when the authorized history is genuinely empty.

NotFound.description: Resource not found, or hidden from caller for privacy

PermissionsEpoch.description: PAI-320 per-user permissions epoch. The auth middleware sets it on every authenticated response, for session-cookie and `paimos_*` API-key callers alike, so it is always present on a success. The value is the canonical base-10 rendering of a non-negative int64 counter: no sign, no leading zeros, no surrounding whitespace. Clients compare it verbatim against the last value they saw and re-fetch `/auth/me` on any change, so a non-canonical rendering would silently invalidate that comparison. The pattern is exact on both ends: the counter is a signed int64 column rendered by `strconv.FormatInt`, so 9223372036854775807 is the largest value that can ever appear. The 19-digit alternatives encode that ceiling — one branch per prefix of the maximum whose next digit is lowered, plus the maximum itself — because JSON Schema has no numeric bound for a string-typed header.

SessionExpiresAt.description: PAI-322 session expiry. Present only when the request authenticated with a session cookie; absent for `paimos_*` API-key callers, so clients must treat it as optional. The value is the session's current expiry in UTC as an RFC 3339 date-time.

parameters.description: Project lifecycle filter. Omitting it is the same as `active`. A concrete status returns exactly that state. `all` is not a wildcard: it returns the normal lifecycle states — `active`, `frozen` and `archived` — and deliberately excludes `deleted`, which stays reachable only through the explicit `status=deleted` trash view.

Read the authorized Agent Mode delivery snapshot
get.description: Returns schema v1 rows, selector-independent aggregates, and an opaque cursor. Query filters shape rows and aggregates but never broaden authorization. `selected_delivery` may produce the sole `selected_outside` object and is excluded from cursor binding. Portfolio snapshots are bounded to 1,000 authorized candidate roots and reject a larger set rather than truncating it.

400.description: Malformed, duplicate, unsupported, or inconsistent filter, or more than 1,000 authorized candidate roots

404.description: Canonical indistinguishable response for external callers and inaccessible roots

403.description: Authenticated internal caller must change an administrator-set password

500.description: Private storage-invariant failure; no partial snapshot is returned

get.summary: Read a project-scoped Agent Mode delivery snapshot
get.description: The project path is an authorization and stream-audience boundary. Its cursor can resume on the sole events endpoint by supplying the same project_id query value; the sealed cursor selects project-route semantics. Project snapshots are bounded to 1,000 authorized candidate roots and reject a larger set rather than truncating it.

400.description: Malformed project identifier or filter, or more than 1,000 authorized candidate roots in the project scope

404.description: Missing/inaccessible project or canonical external concealment

403.description: Authenticated internal caller must change an administrator-set password

500.description: Private storage-invariant failure; no partial snapshot is returned

get.summary: Read one authorized Agent Mode delivery selection
get.description: A detail path is a selection/lookup surface, not a separate event scope. Its cursor uses the same effective global filter binding as the portfolio snapshot; the delivery key itself is not cursor-bound. Exact authorized detail membership is applied before the 1,000-candidate portfolio ceiling, so unrelated authorized roots cannot hide a valid detail.

200.description: Snapshot containing the selected delivery inside rows or selected_outside

404.description: Missing/inaccessible delivery or canonical external concealment

403.description: Authenticated internal caller must change an administrator-set password

500.description: Private storage-invariant failure; no partial snapshot is returned

get.summary: Stream resumable Agent Mode delivery invalidations
get.description: Server-Sent Events stream. `Last-Event-ID` has absolute precedence over `cursor`. A valid resume produces durable `refetch` events with only currently authorized hints or identity-free `refetch` when convergence requires it, and `checkpoint` events when only the opaque high-water advances. Both use the new opaque cursor as the SSE `id`. Any invalid/tampered/expired/wrong-user/wrong-scope/revoked/below-retention/ahead-of-tail resume produces exactly one identity-free `reset` (`{"schema_version":1,"reason":"resync_required"}`) without an event id, then closes. A fresh stream whose authorized scope exceeds 1,000 candidates returns a private 400 before SSE headers; a resumed stream normalizes that changed scope to the same generic reset. A storage invariant discovered before response headers is a private 500 problem because cursor resynchronization cannot repair storage; the same invariant discovered by an already-established session emits one identity-free reset and closes. Heartbeats are SSE comments.

200.description: SSE `reset`, `refetch`, and `checkpoint` events. Refetch/checkpoint data follows AgentModeStreamBatch; reset data follows AgentModeStreamReset.

schema.description: UTF-8 SSE frames. Event data schemas: AgentModeStreamBatch for refetch/checkpoint; AgentModeStreamReset for reset.

400.description: Malformed non-cursor filter or a fresh authorized scope exceeding 1,000 candidates. Invalid cursor material and a resumed scope that no longer satisfies the bound are normalized to a 200 reset event.

404.description: Canonical external concealment before a stream is opened

403.description: Authenticated internal caller must change an administrator-set password before a stream is opened

500.description: Private pre-stream storage invariant or unavailable streaming transport; no SSE headers have been committed

post.summary: Ephemerally transcribe one final Agent Mode utterance
post.description: Accepts one bounded raw audio blob and returns one final transcript. Audio and transcript are never persisted, cached, or copied into the generic idempotency cache; the AI papertrail stores metadata and billed units only. Intake and Agent Mode share STT concurrency, burst, and daily budgets.

403.description: Internal cookie caller failed CSRF or must change password

415.description: Content-Type is not an allowlisted browser audio/video type

422.description: Audio is empty or no speech was detected

429.description: Shared voice concurrency, burst, AI-cap, or daily-unit budget rejected the call

post.summary: Speak a reauthorized server-owned Agent Mode template
post.description: Never accepts caller text. The server coherently reloads and authorizes the primary plus up to three active candidates, verifies the current delivery revision and required capability, then renders only closed structured facts. Intake and Agent Mode share TTS concurrency, burst, and daily budgets; audio and template text are not persisted.

400.description: Malformed, missing, extra, or inconsistent template fields

403.description: Internal cookie caller failed CSRF or must change password

404.description: Canonical concealment for external, missing, inaccessible, revoked-capability, or inactive candidate targets

429.description: Shared voice concurrency, burst, AI-cap, or daily-unit budget rejected the call

502.description: Synthesis provider failed or returned invalid/non-audio/oversized output
